name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You sure seem eager to work, matey.  Not sure why some land-loving friend champion is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.

Our ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.

All the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies!  What I need is a scout.

Check the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.
narrative.objectives: First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.
narrative.offerRewardText: Inside the skiff, you discover a map with some hastily written text on it along with some coins.
